Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Wants AI Content Fact-Checked, Gemini UTM Tags
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google has updated its AI content guidance to require fact-checking, and Gemini links now include UTM tags. The roundup also notes that desktop CTR fell in Q2 and that two AI-related lawsuits have been dismissed.

AI Search / GEO.title: Impact of AI Search Summaries on Website Traffic
AI Search / GEO.summary: An arXiv paper examining how AI-generated search summaries affect website traffic, offering research-backed insight into the traffic implications of AI answer surfaces for publishers and SEO teams.

AI Search / GEO.title: Inside ChatGPT Search: how web.run and fan-out queries shape AI visibility
AI Search / GEO.summary: This piece examines the internal mechanics of ChatGPT Search, specifically how the web.run tool and fan-out query patterns influence which sources gain AI visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: October 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update, Gemini 3.8, AI Contribution and Monopoly Rulings
AI Search / GEO.summary: A monthly Google webmaster report covering a spam algorithm update, the Gemini 3.8 release, AI contribution features, and ongoing monopoly rulings affecting the search landscape.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Emerges as the Holiday Season's Fastest-Growing Service
AI Search / GEO.summary: GEO is identified as the fastest-growing service heading into the 2026 holiday season, signaling rising enterprise demand for optimization targeting AI-answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Optimizing Visibility in Generative Engines: A Critical Survey of Generative Engine Optimization (2023-2026)
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic survey spanning 2023 to 2026 critically reviews the state of GEO research, providing a structured overview of what is known about influencing visibility in generative AI search engines.

AI Search / GEO.title: When Optimization Becomes Manipulation: Defending Generative Search against Malicious Generative Engine Optimization
AI Search / GEO.summary: This arXiv paper investigates adversarial and manipulative GEO tactics and proposes defenses for generative search systems, relevant for teams navigating the boundary between legitimate optimization and manipulation.
